_comment: Single source of truth for G4 runs. Aligned with interface/config.py: R_MAX=5.0 cm, Z_MAX=25.0 X0, E0 in [10,200] MeV.

geometry._depth_note: 22.25 cm = 25 X0 exactly (X0=0.89 cm) -- matches interface/config.py Z_MAX=25.0
geometry._X0_note: Radiation length of PbWO4 (PDG). Used by convert_to_npz.py to convert z: cm -> X0 units before writing to disk, matching interface/io.py contract.

binning._comment: Non-uniform bins (sqrt-spaced in r, denser near shower max in z) -- see RunData.cc

_energies_note: Bounded to interface/config.py E0_MIN=10, E0_MAX=200. Keep in sync -- if you widen E0 range in config.py, add matching energies here.
